_doc: Born to a Family (player/parentage.js): the New Game origin 'born' makes the player the child of a real couple of the world (townsfolk on settlement.folk, a noble pair of a city, a ruler and consort). Until they come of age their parents set the rules of their days (rules below; bitten in PlayerActions.getAvailableActions, ActionMenu.handleAction, the overworld move and the end of the day). `ties` seeds every other origin's first people (family, friends, a rival, a court).

farmer.name: A farmer's family
farmer.means: Up before the sun. The fields feed you and the family's coin is thin, but it is honest and they will teach you the land.

labourer.name: A labourer's family
labourer.means: Poor folk who work for others: odd days, hard hands. Little is forbidden that costs nothing, and little is given.

smith.name: A smith's family
smith.means: The forge's heat and the hammer's ring. A trade to learn at your father's anvil, and a decent table.

merchant.name: A merchant's family
merchant.means: Ledgers, scales and the market's noise. Comfortable, watchful with coin, and set on you learning your numbers.

guard.name: A guardsman's family
guard.means: A parent in the town watch: discipline, a curfew kept to the bell, and no patience at all for thieving.

priest.name: A priest's family
priest.means: Raised in the shadow of the church. Learning and prayer, a strict house, and a parish that watches you.

guildmaster.name: A guildmaster's family
guildmaster.means: A parent heads the town's guild. Money, standing, a workshop to learn in, and a name the masters know.

noble.name: A noble family
noble.means: Lords of land and tenants. Fine clothes and a tutor, an inheritance if you are first in line, and a marriage they mean to choose for you.

royal.name: The royal family
royal.means: A prince or princess of the realm, in the line of succession. Everything is given you except your freedom.

farm.label: Work the fields
farm.desc: A day behind the plough and among the sheaves with your family.

labour.label: Help with the day's labour
labour.desc: Carry, haul and dig beside your parents for whoever hires them today.

forge.label: Work the bellows at the forge
forge.desc: Pump the bellows, quench, sweep the scale, and learn a little of the hammer.

shop.label: Mind the stall
shop.desc: Weigh, haggle and keep the ledger while your parents buy in.

watch.label: Run errands for the watch
watch.desc: Carry messages, clean the armour, stand where you are told.

parish.label: Serve in the parish
parish.desc: Sweep the nave, ring the bell, sit with the sick.

workshop.label: Work in the guild workshop
workshop.desc: Fetch, sort and learn the trade's marks under the masters' eyes.

estate.label: Ride the estates with your parent
estate.desc: Hear the tenants, see the rents counted, learn what land is worth.

court.label: Attend court
court.desc: Stand beside the throne through a day of petitions and ceremony.

letters.label: Lessons in letters and numbers
letters.desc: Reading, sums and the keeping of accounts.

scripture.label: Lessons in scripture
scripture.desc: The holy texts, read aloud and learned by heart.

tutor.label: Lessons with your tutor
tutor.desc: History, rhetoric, arms and the manners of the great.

church.label: Go to church with the family
church.desc: Sit through the service beside your parents, where the town can see you.

curfew.name: Home by nightfall
curfew.desc: End every day under your parents' roof.
curfew.text: You were not home by nightfall. {parents} sat up waiting.

roam.name: Stay near home
roam.desc: No further than {radius} leagues from home without leave.
roam.text: You went off beyond where you may go, without leave. Word has reached {parents}.

tavern.name: No taverns
tavern.desc: Taverns and alehouses are no place for you.
tavern.text: You were seen in the tavern. {parents} heard of it before you were home.

gambling.name: No gambling
gambling.desc: Not a coin on dice or cards.
gambling.text: You were gambling, and {parents} found out.

army.name: No soldiering
army.desc: No raising men, no sellsword's contracts, no army, without their leave.
army.text: You went for a soldier without their leave. {parents} are beside themselves.

crime.name: No thieving or brawling
crime.desc: No theft, smuggling, the underworld, or picking fights.
crime.text: Word of what you did reached {parents}. They are ashamed of you.

marry.name: No marrying without consent
marry.desc: You may not court or wed without their blessing.
marry.text: You married without their blessing. {parents} will not speak your spouse's name.

chores.name: Do your share
chores.desc: Help in the family's work at least every {every} days.
chores.text: You shirked your share of the work again. {parents} noticed.

lessons.name: Your lessons
lessons.desc: Sit your lessons at least every {every} days.
lessons.text: You skipped your lessons. {parents} heard from your teacher.

church.name: Church with the family
church.desc: Go to church with them at least every {every} days.
church.text: Your place in the pew was empty again. {parents} were asked where you were.

escalation._doc: Strikes count within `window` days. Each step applies once when the count reaches it.

steps.text: You are grounded for {days} days: home, and nowhere else.
Your allowance is stopped for {days} days.
Grounded again, for {days} days, and the chores doubled.
Enough. You are sent to live with {relative} in {town}, under their roof and their rules.
{parents} disown you. You are no child of theirs, and you will inherit nothing.

grounded.text: You are grounded for {days} more days.

travel.name: Ask leave to travel
travel.desc: Ten days' leave to go further afield.

army.name: Ask leave to take up arms
army.desc: Their blessing to soldier: recruit, take contracts, ride with an army.

court.name: Ask leave to court
court.desc: Their blessing to court someone, and wed them.

apprentice.name: Ask to go out into the world
apprentice.desc: Their blessing to leave home now: apprenticed, in service, or on your own road. Their rule over you ends.

runAway.text: You slip out before dawn with what you can carry. You are your own now, and {parents} will not forget it.

lines.welcome: You are {name}, {age} years old, {childWord} of {father} and {mother}, {station} of {town}{realm}. {siblingsLine}{means} Your parents set your rules until you are {comeOfAge}: see Your Parents.
lines.welcomePending: You are about to be born. Choose your parents (or let fate choose).
lines.comeOfAge: You are {age}: of age. {parents} let you go with their blessing{gift}.
lines.orphaned: With your parents gone, no one rules your days now.
lines.allowanceShort: There is nothing to spare this week: no allowance.
lines.defy: Your parents forbid this. Doing it anyway risks: {consequence}
lines.crowned: Your parent is dead, and you are first in line: you are crowned in {kingdom}.
lines.crownAwaits: Your parent is dead. You are first in line, but under age: the realm is held for you until you are {comeOfAge}.
lines.lineLost: Your parent is dead, and the crown passes to {heir}, ahead of you in the line.

ties._doc: Every origin's first people (Parentage.seedTies): parents living (0-2), siblings, where the family lives ('home' = the start town, 'away' = another town), friends, acquaintances, a rival in the start town, and a court of retainers for landed, noble, royal and guild origins (Court.join, free).
